dedupe_keys.name: simulation dataset project spectrum of public transit operations from fixed route to microtransit

description: Joseph Chow and colleagues at New York University publish synthetic passenger-demand inputs for comparing mobility services along the MTA B63 bus route in Brooklyn. The February 2020 deposit provides three MATLAB files, representing 80, 200 and 400 passengers per hour. Each contains passenger origins and destinations within the service area. The files are freely available under CC BY 4.0 and can drive fixed-route or flexible-transit simulation experiments under different demand levels. They are generated scenarios, not observed passenger trips. Coordinate conventions, the generation horizon and random-seed details remain unknown from the landing-page summary. A prior-review draft describes the associated transit simulation sandbox, but does not explicitly identify these three demand pools. This record therefore covers the separately published input data. The MATLAB files were not downloaded and no simulation was run.
